RK322x legacy menu from sources/multistrap/multitool.sh (baseline source review)

1 Backup flash
2 Restore flash
3 Erase flash
4 Drop to Bash shell
5 Burn image to flash
A Change DDR Command Rate (only without detected NAND)
8 Reboot
9 Shutdown

When NAND is detected, options 6 (Install Jump start on NAND) and 7
(Install Armbian via steP-nand) are also offered. The menu is conditional;
this fixture records the RK322x non-NAND case and the additional NAND entries.
